description:
# Half-Day tour of Boston and Cambridge from the comfort of a heated and air-conditioned modern minivan. 

##Details
- 4 hours
- Max of 6 people per tour
- Pickup at location of your choice

##About
This half-day driving tour takes you through the highlights of Boston and Cambridge. The drive will include sights such as the Old North Church, Paul Revere's house, Faneuil Hall, Boston Common, Beacon Hill, Bunker Hill Monument, USS Constitution, Harvard, MIT, Copley Square, Boston Public Library and so much more! The tour is mainly driving, however we will (optionally) stop a few times to briefly (5-10 minutes) get out of the car for photo opportunities and a closer look at some sights! Listen to stories about Boston's past, learning about the American Revolution and the city's duality of religious morals and corruption.

Pick-up and drop-off from/to Boston's cruise ship terminal, Boston Logan Airport, hotels in the Boston area, etc are included in the tour. The tour minivan seats 6 people + small space for luggage or less people with more space for luggage.
